name: CompareView
intent: Compares two geo-aligned sources. `swipe` stacks them and reveals more of one as you drag a center divider; `side-by-side` splits the box into two panes. With `interactive`, the content pans (drag) and zooms (wheel); in side-by-side a lock on the divider keeps both panes in sync. Pass any nodes (images, maps, canvases) for `before`/`after`.

usage: Use CompareView to enhance your user interface. This component provides a consistent, accessible, and well-designed solution for this use case.
CompareView integrates seamlessly with other components in the design system. Follow the established patterns and guidelines to ensure consistency across your application.

props.name: before
props.description: First source (e.g. as-planned / yesterday). Fills the box; the two sources should be geo-aligned.

props.name: after
props.description: Second source (e.g. as-built / today). Omit to show `before` alone as a single pan/zoom map.

props.name: mode
props.description: `swipe` (default) overlays the two with a draggable reveal divider; `side-by-side` shows two panes.

props.name: position
props.description: Divider position as a percentage 0–100 (swipe mode). Controlled when provided.

props.name: beforeLabel
props.description: Optional chip labels for each source.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Make the content pannable (drag) and zoomable (wheel). The two sources stay geo-aligned.

props.name: locked
props.description: Side-by-side + interactive: when locked, both panes pan/zoom together in the same coordinates. Controlled when provided; the lock toggle sits on the dividing line.
